answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can influence shared work, then slash that stake when independent reviewers verify fraud. Give new identities little weight until they build a horizon of useful, accepted contributions; a trellis of cross-checked endorsements can raise influence, but endorsements from the same cluster count only once. A sybil attacker must therefore fund many stakes and sustain distinct, credible histories rather than cheaply minting names. Even a tiny ember of misconduct risks losing capital and accumulated reputation.
